text:
lucia: Photo drop  - Milo discovered the festival lantern box and is now a living paper lantern. refuses to move. (pic attached) :lantern:

omar: this is peak cozy halloween but make it year-round :jack_o_lantern:

nate: is that legal? a cat in a lantern? safety check: any sharp edges?

lucia: all plastic and rounded, no worries. he wiggled in through a side slit and instantly went full loaf-mode.

sasha: caption contest: 1) "Light of my life" 2) "Lantern loaf" 3) "Glow up" react 1/2/3 or reply other

omar: 2 for the pun longevity.

nate: 3, also adding tiny fairy lights to the wishlist.

pet-bot: lucia added a file: milo-lantern-loaf.jpg (900KB)

lucia: pro tip: if you attempt this, supervise closely and make sure the opening is wide enough for escape. also bribe with treats.

sasha: can we make a rule: all pet photos must include a safety note if props are used :heart:

omar: love that. also adding a recurring "Friday pet drop" calendar event. who wants an invite?

nate: in. i'll bring mini LED lights for moral support.

lucia: thanks y'all. Milo sends a muffled purr and demands pats through the paper.
